name: What is the process for creating a custom tiny home floor plan?
description: The process involves consultation, initial sketches, revisions based on your feedback, and finalization of the detailed floor plan.

mainEntity.name: What is the process for creating a custom tiny home floor plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process begins with an initial consultation to understand your vision, requirements, and budget. We then create preliminary sketches and 3D renderings for your review. Based on your feedback, we refine the design through several iterations. Once approved, the detailed floor plan is finalized, ready for the next stages of construction planning. We involve you at every step to ensure the final design meets your expectations.
